name: Lightweight and Spatial Structures
description: Introduction and overview of spatial structures; analysis of tensile membrane structures; cable-nets and pneumatic structures; lattice and grid-shell structures; tensegrity and deployable structures; funicular-shell structures; dynamic and geometric based form-finding analysis: dynamic relaxation methods, force-density method, thrust-network analysis; load analysis and stability check; dynamic analysis; shape and size optimization for grid-shell structures; structural morphology; conceptual design and steering of form; robust design optimization using heuristics; case studies for different spatial structures.
